verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage claims you can 'describe the audience, journey, or growth goal' and that 'mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use,' which matches the core of natural-language audience building grounded in customer data. That claim is only a marketing tagline, with no technical documentation or hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: documentation of the NL-to-segment feature, evidence that generated definitions are presented for review before activation, evidence of how it is grounded in the user's actual schema/data plan, independent or hands-on corroboration.
